notes:
POC objective: validate Dedicated capacity sizing and SLA terms for production chat + reranking workloads. Short fragments — key ask: 99.95% uptime SLA, latency SLO p95 <= 300ms for chat (average prompt ~120 tokens), and sustained throughput of 5k tokens/sec with headroom for burst to 8k tokens/sec. We scoped reserved GPU plan at 4x A100-equivalent GPUs initially, but Elmwood's perf team asked for sizing guidance: estimate 6-8 GPUs for sustained 5k t/s with quantization and batching. They are cost-sensitive — asked for a cost-per-1M-token at configured batching settings (Ravi to produce).

Load/soak plan (agreed):
- Representative prompt mix: 60% short chat (50-150 tokens), 25% reranking micro-prompts (20-50 tokens, high QPS), 15% embeddings/summarization (500-1k tokens).
- Load tests: step ramp to 5k tokens/sec over 30m, hold 2h, step to 8k tokens/sec for 30m, check tail latencies and OOMs.
- Soak test: 72 hours at 60% sustained utilization (approx 3k t/s) with hourly perf snapshots and daily mem/KV cache health checks.
- Failure modes: cold-start latency spikes, KV cache churn, model fallback behavior when capacity constrained. We'll validate graceful fallback to smaller quantized model variant per routing policy.

Representative prompts used in test harness (examples paraphrased):
- Short chat: "Summarize the last message and suggest next action." (50-120 tokens)
- Reranking micro-call: pass 10 candidates + query; expect top-3 ranking within 200ms/p95 target for micro-prompts when possible.
- Long summarization: 750 token doc -> 100 token summary (stress on generation throughput).

Benchmark notes: initial 1-GPU run showed p95 ~420ms (short chat), p50 ~110ms; KV cache reuse improved p95 by ~20% in subsequent runs. Continuous batching settings matter: 25ms batching window increased throughput by 18% but added 30-40ms to p95 for single-turn requests; Elmwood wants configurable knobs.

SLA negotiation points we raised: credits for missed latency SLOs (sliding scale), a defined escalation path, scheduled maintenance windows, and data residency clause for EU-only tenants. Elmwood legal flagged indemnity language and retention limits; need Sec/Legal input.

Blockers/ask list to push POC forward: final SOC2 evidence (they need 3rd-party attestation), 48h network peering slot from Elmwood infra, explicit cost bake for dedicated 4 vs 8 GPU configs, confirmation of KMS/HSM hybrid keyflow.

Customer quote paraphrase: "We can't risk tail latency regressions at peak — latency is directly tied to conversion on our chat flows. Need guaranteed headroom, not just averages."

Next items owner map: Jordan - contract/SLA; Ravi - technical runbook + cost model; Alejandra - success criteria + onboarding checklist. Deliverables: 72h soak report, cost/perf matrix, draft SLA redline.
